notes.title: New big update and new price
notes.content:
[h1]We listen to you! We just released a quite big update of Aero's Quest based on your initial feedback. And we dropped the price as well![/h1]
If you think that the Summer Sale is just over you are wrong: we dropped the price of the game to announce a big update:
Since release day we've listened to every single feedback, we've watched every single video and we have read all the reviews ... and we made all the fixes you've been asking for:
[list]
[*][b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]: the trading cards of Aero's Quest are now available
[*][b]Controls[/b]: we recalibrated the control system and now the game is more responsive and more tight. 
[*][b]Remapping Keys[/b]: if you like to play with the keyboard now you can remap your own keys.
[*][b]Options saving[/b]: the options are now saving and kept in memory.
[*][b]Steam Screenshots[/b]: is now possible to take steam screenshots of the game with the key F12.
[*][b]Sound effects[/b]: little changes here and there in the sound effect department.
[*][b]Random patterns[/b]: there is no more random component in the pattern of few obstacles making the game a bit more easy.
[*][b]Small bug fixes[/b]
[/list]

Thanks again for your warm support!

[i]note: mac users (depending from the computer and the system) may have to uninstall and re-install the game[/i]
